Reflection: Sub-par but we had 3 different lecturers, since Rosella was on maternity leave.
Found most of the content quite interesting, but only when engaging at my own pace.
Not the worst, but also not the best. Structure makes sense, but does repeat some stuff from cs132/241.

Any enjoyment I found from this module was found from random YouTube/Wikipedia rabbitholes, not the lectures themselves.
